decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the core coolant-management business, it is still a low-cost option to retain and its survival so far suggests no strong reason to abandon it.

Even if individual nozzle variants may later be streamlined, the product line is close to the established offer and inexpensive enough to keep while the firm continues to learn about demand across models.

This conveyor remains somewhat more exposed because it is adjacent rather than fully central to the core portfolio, but for a large machinery firm the option value of staying in the segment still outweighs immediate withdrawal.
Because it fits the existing chip-conveying portfolio, installed base and service network well, it remains an attractive complementary option with limited incremental risk.
